surface finish is highly sensitive to finishing temperature, and tensile strength is directly proportional to orientation angle of the part.
the orientation angle of 30° with finishing temperature of 80°C and finishing time of 30 min is the best set of parameters to achieve maximum strength and minimum surface roughness.
the surface roughness is inversely proportional to finishing time, and directly proportional to finishing temperature and orientation angle.

the development of a new chemical finishing technique, which can be easily applied in industry to improve the surface quality and mechanical properties of FDM parts.
optimization of FDM process parameters to achieve desired surface roughness and mechanical strength.
optimization of FDM process parameters and chemical vapour finishing process parameters for manufacturing of ABS parts.

, a finishing temperature of 80 °C and finishing time of 30 minutes are recommended to achieve the best possible combination of surface finish and mechanical strength.
